# Field System

The field system provides storage and operations for data defined on CSR geometries.

## Field2D Template

```cpp
template <typename T, class MemorySpace>
struct Field2D {
  IntervalSet2D<MemorySpace> geometry;  // Associated geometry
  Kokkos::View<T*, MemorySpace> data;   // Field values (size = total_cells)
};
```

## Operations

- `field_transform()` - Apply element-wise transformations
- `field_copy()` - Copy fields between memory spaces
- `field_fill()` - Initialize with constant value

## Host/Device Synchronization

```cpp
// Device → Host
auto host_field = build_host_field_from_device(device_field);

// Host → Device
auto dev_field = build_device_field_from_host(host_field);
```

## Location

- Header: `include/subsetix/field/field_2d.hpp`
- Operations: `include/subsetix/csr_ops/field_*`
